title: Uncovering Retail Trading in Bitcoin: The Impact of COVID-19 Stimulus Checks
eligible_reason: Main analysis compares trade-size bins just below vs above $1,200 (treated) across stimulus phases (announced, disbursed) of the single April 2020 US EIP program: one date, a three-level phase factor (two treatment regressors), estimated by fractional quasibinomial GLM (feglm) with date, currency and exchange FE. Other countries' programs (JPY, KRW, SGD) are analysed separately in Online Appendix B, each with its own single date.
design_notes: main.R Tables 5-7: fixest::feglm(per_tradevol ~ stim_start_phase * treated | date + symbol + exchange, family = quasibinomial). Table 9: feols(ln_diff_avg_price ~ stim_start_phase * diff_trt_ctrl_lag_v2 + lagged outcome | exchange_id + date).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: US EIP phases common to all USD trades on US-domiciled exchanges.
excluded_specs_summary: Tables 5-7: quasibinomial GLM, single date, two phase indicators. Table 9: continuous treatment and lagged outcome. Appendix B event studies per country, each single-date.
data_provenance_note: README: 'small random samples for each table... not designed to be representative of the full Kaiko data set'; full Kaiko trade data proprietary. Whether rows are genuine or randomized was not verified (design ineligible regardless).
